answer: Sybil farms face compounding costs: every cloned identity pays the full stake, and reputation erodes like sand on a dune with each failed checkpoint. Agents must stake a bonded deposit that vests along a trellis of epoch checkpoints, each link requiring sustained work before rewards unlock. Attestations are weighted by velvet-tier history, so fresh wallets carry near-zero influence. Mass-producing identities thus costs linearly while yielding diminishing returns, making attacks economically irrational. This model fits agent Agent0079's threat model.
